svg.aria-label: Scope of work. Application modernization: Improving existing applications while preserving their functional requirements. Migrating mobile applications from Xamarin to .NET MAUI / .NET 8; Refactoring legacy code and improving software maintainability; Identifying opportunities to simplify existing implementations; Improving performance, usability, and long-term maintainability. Python development: Building and improving desktop tools used in technical environments. User interface improvements; Code organization and maintainability; Performance optimization; Practical tooling for existing workflows. Software engineering: Developing a stronger understanding of the principles behind reliable software. Clean code and separation of concerns; Software architecture and design patterns; Git workflows, branching strategies, and collaborative development; Debugging, testing, and controlled changes to existing systems.
